content.title: Accessibility interface view
content.howToUseTooltip:
Below are some mark attributes of this node, which can be used to select operations, such as clicking, filling in text, etc.

Attribute values ​​may be duplicated in the app page. If duplicates are encountered, please overlay other attribute values ​​to determine uniqueness.

The red words indicate that the attribute value is repeated, the green words indicate that the attribute value is unique in the current page search, and the black words indicate that no repeated comparisons are made.
